candidates.excerpt: New Delhi: The Group of Seven (G7) nations and their partners are set to release up to 100 million barrels of emergency oil and diesel stocks over the next four months as governments seek to ease surging fuel prices. The release will be coordinated by the International Energy Agency (IEA), French President Emmanuel Macron said …

candidates.title: Samajwadi Party preaches social justice but gives tickets to the privileged, Mayawati alleges
candidates.excerpt: The BSP president warned the backward classes, Dalits, tribals, and minorities to be aware of the SP’s double standards.

candidates.title: Congress appoints Pargat Singh as new Punjab chief, Warring resigns
candidates.excerpt: AICC’s decision puts an end to months of uncertainty; Warring submits his resignation as PPCC chief to Rahul Gandhi

candidates.title: Telangana borrowings set to exceed annual target by December
candidates.excerpt: Telangana's market borrowings are expected to exceed the annual target of Rs 58,458.71 crore by December, with proposed third-quarter borrowings taking the total to Rs 59,400 crore. Having already utilised nearly 80 per cent of its annual borrowing limit in the first two quarters, the State is likely to raise additional funds in the January-March quarter.

candidates.title: Man Taken Into Custody For Throwing Sticks At Santoshi Mata Idol In Hyderabad Temple
candidates.excerpt: A video purportedly showing the man entering the sanctum sanctorum of the Santoshi Mata temple and throwing sticks at the idol was circulated on social media. The priest and some devotees were seen offering prayers at the time

candidates.title: Illegal vape-selling network busted in Madhapur, four arrested
candidates.excerpt: The Eagle Force and Madhapur police arrested four persons after raiding two outlets allegedly involved in selling banned vapes and foreign cigarettes. Police seized 92 vapes, 15 cigarette packets and two scanners and registered cases under multiple laws

candidates.title: Gutkha manufacturing unit busted in Hyderabad, three held
candidates.excerpt: Task Force and Asifnagar police busted an alleged illegal gutkha and tobacco manufacturing unit at Muradnagar, Hyderabad, and seized material and machinery worth around Rs 50 lakh. Three workers were arrested and two children allegedly employed there were rescued.

candidates.excerpt: During questioning, the accused allegedly admitted to their involvement and told police that the attacks were carried out due to previous enmity
